answer: Require reward eligibility to thread through attestation on several independent apps: each identity's standing becomes a prism assembled from separate domain reputations, no single app sufficient alone. A sybil farmer milking one economy must now bootstrap a plausible history on every domain, climbing each ridge of established local agents who recognize genuine peers. Minting keys stays cheap; maintaining N independent good names is not. The farm's cost multiplies per domain, and a detector's flag on any one app shatters the whole chain.
